hook_candidates.spoken: You can spot phishing by the bad spelling? Not with AI.
How do you spot a phishing email without a single mistake?
Germany's BSI says typos are now rarely a clear sign of phishing.
hook_candidates.on_screen: Typos? Rarely a sign any more

hook_candidates.spoken: A flawless email from the bank can still be fake.
Thursday, 8:55 a.m. An email from your bank, without a single mistake.
hook_candidates.visual: clock, the bank email arrives as a paper card, the threatening line is marked

beats.spoken: Thursday, 8:55 a.m. An email from your bank: Please confirm your login details today, or your account will be suspended.

mail.subject: Security check due
lines: today, or your account is locked.

beats.spoken: You check it the way you were taught. Language: flawless. Greeting: your name. Tone: polite. Not a single mistake. But according to the NCSC, AI already writes lures without the mistakes that often gave phishing away.

fact.text: AI writes lures without the typical phishing mistakes.

beats.spoken: What do you do? A: No mistakes, so it's real. You click the link. B: You reply and ask. C: You go to the bank's site yourself, from your own bookmark. Remember your choice.

options.text: No mistakes, so it's real: click
Reply to the email and ask
Go to the bank's site yourself

beats.spoken: Let's play out A. The link leads to a login page that looks just like always. You enter your login details. According to the BSI, that's exactly what these pages are for: criminals harvest passwords there.

The right answer is C. Germany's BSI says trustworthy institutions don't ask you by email to change sensitive data via a link. Microsoft advises going to the site yourself. A only checks the form. B asks the very sender in question.

card.title: Open the bank site yourself
card.sub: from your bookmark, never the link

beats.spoken: And if you've already entered your details? Then call your bank straight away to block access, and check your transactions with them.
Check the intent, not the spelling. What would you have picked? Tell me in the comments.
